title: Cumulative Product
text: Cumulative product of channel, column, or row elements, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset type; {Multiply input along} sets the dimension to multiply input along Channels, {Input processing}, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Intermediate product}, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Multiply input along
params.values: Dimension to multiply input along Channels (running product) (default) | Columns | Rows

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Input processing Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset type None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Intermediate product
params.values: Intermediate product Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
